This guide separates changes already in effect from products still sold. Trip and payment-planning suggestions are BAYLINK editorial advice; current operator rules govern fares and eligibility.

SFMTA：Lifeline 月票并入 Clipper START: SFMTA: the Lifeline pass moves to Clipper START
2027 年 1 月 1 日起改用 Clipper START；12 月 1 日: Clipper START from January 1, 2027; apply by December 1.
从 2026 年 9 月 1 日起，MuniMobile 已停止销售新的单程票。: Since September 1, 2026, MuniMobile has stopped selling new single-ride tickets. For October trips, use Clipper or a contactless bank card for adult fares. During 2026 the app still sells Muni-only Day Passes, cable car tickets, Lifeline passes and 1-, 3- and 7-day Visitor Passports. SFMTA is retiring the app in stages and expects to leave it completely by mid-2027; its proposed schedule for that is in the January 2027 section below.
先按乘客资格选付款方式: Choose payment by rider eligibility first
普通成人：实体感应银行卡、手机钱包中的银行卡或 Clipper 都是可选方式；实: Adult riders can use a contactless bank card, a bank card in a mobile wallet, or Clipper. A plastic card needs the contactless symbol to tap; a chip alone is not enough.
青年、长者、Clipper Access 或 START 乘客：要用对应优惠 C: Youth, Senior, Clipper Access, and START riders need the applicable discount Clipper card for those program fares. A direct bank-card tap charges adult fare.
多人同行：每位乘客分别准备自己的付款卡或设备。一次行程的进出站使用同一张卡或同一: Each rider needs their own payment card or device. Use the same card or device when tapping in and out; do not switch between plastic, phone, and watch.
两小时换乘优惠怎么纳入十月预算: How to include the two-hour transfer discount in an October budget
新一代 Clipper 提供符合条件的两小时跨机构换乘最高 2.85 美元优惠，: Next-generation Clipper offers up to $2.85 off qualifying interagency transfers within two hours, including eligible contactless bank-card journeys. MTC's September report says older cards are still migrating; before using an existing Clipper card, check in your account or with customer service whether it has been upgraded. The discount is not a fixed $2.85 rebate or an all-day pass; complete required exit taps.
编辑建议：出发前只做三件事: Editorial suggestion: three checks before departure
先给每位同行者选定付款媒介；再把去程与返程分别查好，不为追换乘优惠赶车；最后记住: Choose a payment method for each rider, plan outward and return trips separately without rushing for a discount, and remember pass coverage: the Muni-only Day Pass excludes cable cars while the Visitor Passport differs. Existing passholders should check their coverage before buying another fare.
1 月 1 日：Lifeline 月票并入 Clipper START。最后一期: January 1: the Lifeline pass moves to Clipper START. The last paper Lifeline stickers go on sale in late November and are valid for December; SFMTA asks anyone who wants to keep Lifeline to apply for a Clipper START card by December 1, 2026 (processing can take up to 30 days) and then buy the Lifeline monthly pass on it.
1 月 3 日：按 SFMTA 公布的退场计划，MuniMobile 停卖不含缆: January 3: under SFMTA’s proposed schedule, MuniMobile stops selling the Single Day Pass (no cable cars); passes bought before then stay valid for 30 days. After that, buy day passes on Clipper, at a Muni Metro ticket machine, or at the farebox when you board (tell the operator before you put money in).
1 月 4 日：Muni 新票价生效。成人单程用 Clipper 从 $2.85: January 4: new Muni fares. The adult single ride on Clipper goes from $2.85 to $3.00 (the Clipper single-ride discount ends; cash stays $3.00); the adult M monthly pass goes from $86 to $90 and the A pass with BART inside San Francisco from $104 to $108; senior, disabled and Clipper START single rides go from $1.40 to $1.50; the senior/disabled monthly pass and the Lifeline pass go from $43 to $45; the Muni one-day pass (no cable cars) goes from $5.70 to $6.00.
同样从 1 月 4 日起：缆车单程 $9 → $12；新增 Cable Car: Also from January 4: the cable car single ride goes from $9 to $12; a new $18 Cable Car Plus day pass covers one adult and up to two youth 18 and under for unlimited cable car and other Muni rides that day; the 1-, 3- and 7-day Visitor Passports are discontinued.
